<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Space in pixels between the plot and its labels.
	const TICK_PADDING = 8;
	// Space in pixels kept clear around the crosshair's time tag.
	const TAG_CLEARANCE = 4;
	const plotRight = $derived(ctx.marginLeft + ctx.plotWidth);

	/** Whether a price label sits under a tag on the price axis, so the tag can cover it cleanly. */
	function isPriceCovered(y: number) {
		return ctx.priceTagYs.some((tagY) => Math.abs(tagY - y) < ctx.tagHeight);
	}

	/** Whether a time label sits under the crosshair's time tag. */
	function isTimeCovered(x: number, label: string) {
		const tag = ctx.timeTag;
		const halfWidth = ctx.measureText([label]) / 2 + TAG_CLEARANCE;
		return !!tag && x + halfWidth > tag.x && x - halfWidth < tag.x + tag.width;
	}
</script>

<!-- Price grid with labels on the right, the trading convention. -->
<g class="candlestickChartGrid">
	{#each ctx.priceTicks as tick (tick)}
		{@const y = ctx.priceToY(tick)}
		{#if ctx.grid}
			<line x1={ctx.marginLeft} x2={plotRight} y1={y} y2={y} />
		{/if}
		{#if !isPriceCovered(y)}
			<text class="candlestickChartTick" x={plotRight + TICK_PADDING} {y} dominant-baseline="middle">{ctx.formatPriceValue(tick)}</text>
		{/if}
	{/each}
</g>

<!-- Time grid through both panes, with labels on calendar boundaries. -->
<g class="candlestickChartGrid">
	{#each ctx.timeTicks as tick (tick.index)}
		{@const x = ctx.x(tick.index)}
		{#if ctx.grid}
			<line x1={x} x2={x} y1={ctx.marginTop} y2={ctx.plotBottom} />
		{/if}
		{#if !isTimeCovered(x, tick.label)}
			<text class="candlestickChartTick" {x} y={ctx.plotBottom + TICK_PADDING} text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="hanging">{tick.label}</text>
		{/if}
	{/each}
</g>

<!-- Volume pane top edge and its highest value. -->
{#if ctx.showVolume && ctx.volumeHeight > 0}
	<g class="candlestickChartGrid">
		<line x1={ctx.marginLeft} x2={plotRight} y1={ctx.volumeTop} y2={ctx.volumeTop} />
		<text class="candlestickChartTick" x={plotRight + TICK_PADDING} y={ctx.volumeTop} dominant-baseline="hanging">{ctx.formatVolumeValue(ctx.maxVolume)}</text>
	</g>
{/if}

<!-- Axis lines along the right and bottom of the plot. -->
<g class="candlestickChartAxis">
	<line x1={plotRight} x2={plotRight} y1={ctx.marginTop} y2={ctx.plotBottom} />
	<line x1={ctx.marginLeft} x2={plotRight} y1={ctx.plotBottom} y2={ctx.plotBottom} />
</g>

<style>
	/* Recessive hairline grid */
	.candlestickChartGrid line {
		shape-rendering: crispEdges;
		stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--border) 70%, transparent);
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	/* Axis lines, one step stronger than the grid */
	.candlestickChartAxis line {
		shape-rendering: crispEdges;
		stroke: var(--border);
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	/* Axis text uses the muted text color */
	.candlestickChartTick {
		fill: var(--muted-foreground);
		font-size: inherit;
	}
</style>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import { getAreaPath, getLinePath } from "#lib/components/ui/chart/utils.js";
	import type { Point } from "#lib/components/ui/chart/utils.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const isCloseLine = $derived(ctx.variant === "line" || ctx.variant === "area");
	// One candle past each edge, so the close line runs to the edge of the plot before the clip.
	const closePoints: Point[] = $derived.by(() => {
		const first = Math.max(0, (ctx.visibleIndexes[0] ?? 0) - 1);
		const last = Math.min(ctx.data.length - 1, (ctx.visibleIndexes.at(-1) ?? -1) + 1);
		return Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, last - first + 1) }, (_, offset): Point => [ctx.x(first + offset), ctx.priceToY(ctx.data[first + offset].close)]);
	});
	const priceBottom = $derived(ctx.marginTop + ctx.priceHeight);
</script>

{#if isCloseLine}
	<!-- Line or area of the closes, for a calmer view of the trend. -->
	<g class="candlestickChartCloses">
		{#if ctx.variant === "area"}
			<path
				class="candlestickChartCloseArea"
				d={getAreaPath(
					closePoints,
					closePoints.map(([x]): Point => [x, priceBottom]),
					"linear",
				)}
			/>
		{/if}
		<path class="candlestickChartCloseLine" d={getLinePath(closePoints, "linear")} />
		{#if ctx.activeIndex >= 0 && ctx.data[ctx.activeIndex]}
			<circle class="candlestickChartCloseDot" cx={ctx.x(ctx.activeIndex)} cy={ctx.priceToY(ctx.data[ctx.activeIndex].close)} r="4" />
		{/if}
	</g>
{:else}
	<!-- One mark per visible candle: a wick and body, or an OHLC bar with open and close ticks; a close at or above the open rises. -->
	<g class="candlestickChartCandles" data-variant={ctx.variant}>
		{#each ctx.visibleIndexes as index (index)}
			{@const candle = ctx.data[index]}
			{@const x = ctx.x(index)}
			{@const openY = ctx.priceToY(candle.open)}
			{@const closeY = ctx.priceToY(candle.close)}
			{@const tick = ctx.bodyWidth / 2}
			<g class="candlestickChartCandle" data-direction={candle.close >= candle.open ? "up" : "down"} data-active={index === ctx.activeIndex || undefined}>
				<line class="candlestickChartWick" x1={x} x2={x} y1={ctx.priceToY(candle.high)} y2={ctx.priceToY(candle.low)} />
				{#if ctx.variant === "ohlc"}
					<!-- Open ticks left and close ticks right, so direction reads without color. -->
					<line class="candlestickChartTick" x1={x - tick} x2={x} y1={openY} y2={openY} />
					<line class="candlestickChartTick" x1={x} x2={x + tick} y1={closeY} y2={closeY} />
				{:else}
					<!-- A flat candle keeps a 1px body, so it still shows. -->
					<rect class="candlestickChartBody" x={x - ctx.bodyWidth / 2} y={Math.min(openY, closeY)} width={ctx.bodyWidth} height={Math.max(1, Math.abs(closeY - openY))} />
				{/if}
			</g>
		{/each}
	</g>
{/if}

<style>
	.candlestickChartWick {
		shape-rendering: crispEdges;
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	.candlestickChartBody {
		transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
	}

	/* Line of the closes */
	.candlestickChartCloseLine {
		fill: none;
		stroke: var(--candlestick-chart-line, var(--chart-1));
		stroke-linecap: round;
		stroke-linejoin: round;
		stroke-width: 2px;
	}

	/* Soft wash under the close line */
	.candlestickChartCloseArea {
		fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--candlestick-chart-line, var(--chart-1)) 12%, transparent);
	}

	/* 8px dot on the hovered close, with a ring in the surface color */
	.candlestickChartCloseDot {
		fill: var(--candlestick-chart-line, var(--chart-1));
		stroke: var(--candlestick-chart-surface, var(--background));
		stroke-width: 2px;
	}

	/* =============== Variants =============== */

	/* Rising candles */
	.candlestickChartCandle[data-direction="up"] :is(.candlestickChartWick, .candlestickChartTick) {
		stroke: var(--candlestick-chart-up, var(--chart-3));
	}

	.candlestickChartCandle[data-direction="up"] .candlestickChartBody {
		fill: var(--candlestick-chart-up, var(--chart-3));
	}

	/* Falling candles */
	.candlestickChartCandle[data-direction="down"] :is(.candlestickChartWick, .candlestickChartTick) {
		stroke: var(--candlestick-chart-down, var(--destructive));
	}

	.candlestickChartCandle[data-direction="down"] .candlestickChartBody {
		fill: var(--candlestick-chart-down, var(--destructive));
	}

	/* Hollow rising bodies, a second cue besides color */
	.candlestickChartCandles[data-variant="hollow"] .candlestickChartCandle[data-direction="up"] .candlestickChartBody {
		fill: var(--candlestick-chart-surface, var(--background));
		stroke: var(--candlestick-chart-up, var(--chart-3));
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	/* OHLC bars use thicker strokes, since they have no body */
	.candlestickChartCandles[data-variant="ohlc"] :is(.candlestickChartWick, .candlestickChartTick) {
		stroke-width: 1.5px;
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Hovered candle lifts slightly */
	.candlestickChartCandle[data-active] .candlestickChartBody {
		filter: brightness(1.12);
	}
</style>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Space in pixels around a tag's text.
	const TAG_PADDING = 5;
	const tagHeight = $derived(ctx.tagHeight);
	const plotRight = $derived(ctx.marginLeft + ctx.plotWidth);
	const x = $derived(ctx.x(ctx.activeIndex));
	const y = $derived(ctx.crosshairY);
	const priceText = $derived(ctx.formatPriceValue(ctx.yToPrice(y)));
</script>

<!-- Crosshair: a vertical line snapped to the candle, a horizontal line at the pointer, and tags on both axes. -->
{#if ctx.timeTag}
	<g class="candlestickChartCrosshair">
		<line x1={x} x2={x} y1={ctx.marginTop} y2={ctx.plotBottom} />
		<line x1={ctx.marginLeft} x2={plotRight} y1={y} y2={y} />
		<rect class="candlestickChartCrosshairTag" x={plotRight + 1} y={y - tagHeight / 2} width={ctx.measureText([priceText]) + TAG_PADDING * 2} height={tagHeight} />
		<text class="candlestickChartCrosshairText" x={plotRight + 1 + TAG_PADDING} {y} dominant-baseline="middle">{priceText}</text>
		<rect class="candlestickChartCrosshairTag" x={ctx.timeTag.x} y={ctx.plotBottom + 2} width={ctx.timeTag.width} height={tagHeight} />
		<text class="candlestickChartCrosshairText" x={ctx.timeTag.x + ctx.timeTag.width / 2} y={ctx.plotBottom + 2 + tagHeight / 2} text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">{ctx.timeTag.text}</text>
	</g>
{/if}

<style>
	/* Recessive hairlines */
	.candlestickChartCrosshair line {
		shape-rendering: crispEdges;
		stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted-foreground) 60%, transparent);
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	/* Inverted tag, so it reads over the axis labels it covers */
	.candlestickChartCrosshairTag {
		fill: var(--foreground);
		rx: var(--radius-xs);
	}

	.candlestickChartCrosshairText {
		fill: var(--background);
		font-size: inherit;
	}
</style>

{#each ctx.series as item (item.label)} {@const isShown = !ctx.hidden.includes(item.label)}
    • {/each}

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Space in pixels around a tag's text, and between a label and its line.
	const TAG_PADDING = 5;
	const LABEL_OFFSET = 4;
	const plotRight = $derived(ctx.marginLeft + ctx.plotWidth);
	const tagHeight = $derived(ctx.tagHeight);
</script>

<!-- Dashed lines mark levels, since they are thresholds rather than data; each gets a price tag on the axis. -->
<g class="candlestickChartLevels">
	{#each ctx.levelTags as level (level.position)}
		<g style:--candlestick-chart-series-color={level.color}>
			{#if level.placement === "inside"}
				<line class="candlestickChartLevelLine" x1={ctx.marginLeft} x2={plotRight} y1={level.lineY} y2={level.lineY} data-last={level.isLast || undefined} />
				{#if level.label}
					<text class="candlestickChartLevelLabel" x={ctx.marginLeft + LABEL_OFFSET} y={level.lineY - LABEL_OFFSET}>{level.label}</text>
				{/if}
			{/if}
			<rect class="candlestickChartLevelTag" x={plotRight + 1} y={level.tagY - tagHeight / 2} width={ctx.measureText([level.text]) + TAG_PADDING * 2} height={tagHeight} />
			<text class="candlestickChartLevelText" x={plotRight + 1 + TAG_PADDING} y={level.tagY} dominant-baseline="middle">{level.text}</text>
		</g>
	{/each}
</g>

<style>
	/* Dashed threshold line in the level color */
	.candlestickChartLevelLine {
		shape-rendering: crispEdges;
		stroke: var(--candlestick-chart-series-color);
		stroke-dasharray: 4 3;
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	/* The latest close uses a dotted line, apart from the dashed levels */
	.candlestickChartLevelLine[data-last] {
		stroke-dasharray: 1 3;
	}

	/* Level name; text stays in text colors */
	.candlestickChartLevelLabel {
		fill: var(--muted-foreground);
		font-size: inherit;
	}

	/* Axis tag outlined in the level color */
	.candlestickChartLevelTag {
		fill: var(--popover);
		rx: var(--radius-xs);
		stroke: var(--candlestick-chart-series-color);
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	.candlestickChartLevelText {
		fill: var(--popover-foreground);
		font-size: inherit;
	}
</style>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import { getAreaPath, getLinePath } from "#lib/components/ui/chart/utils.js";
	import type { Point } from "#lib/components/ui/chart/utils.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// One candle past each edge, so lines run to the edge of the plot before the clip.
	const indexes = $derived.by(() => {
		const first = Math.max(0, (ctx.visibleIndexes[0] ?? 0) - 1);
		const last = Math.min(ctx.data.length - 1, (ctx.visibleIndexes.at(-1) ?? -1) + 1);
		return Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, last - first + 1) }, (_, offset) => first + offset);
	});
	const overlays = $derived(
		ctx.visibleSeries.map((item) => ({
			...item,
			lineRuns: getRuns(item.line, item.breaks),
			bandRuns: item.bands.map((band) => ({ deviations: band.deviations, upper: getRuns(band.upper, item.breaks), lower: getRuns(band.lower, item.breaks) })),
		})),
	);

	/** Splits values into unbroken runs of points, so warm-up candles and restarts, such as a new VWAP day, leave no false line. */
	function getRuns(values: number[], breaks: number[]) {
		const runs: Point[][] = [];
		let current: Point[] | null = null;
		for (const index of indexes) {
			const value = values[index];
			// If the value is not defined yet: end the current run.
			if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
				current = null;
				continue;
			}
			// If the indicator restarts here: begin a new run.
			if (!current || breaks.includes(index)) {
				current = [];
				runs.push(current);
			}
			current.push([ctx.x(index), ctx.priceToY(value)]);
		}
		return runs;
	}
</script>

<!-- Band fills first, then their edges, then every main line on top. -->
<g class="candlestickChartOverlays">
	{#each overlays as overlay (overlay.label)}
		{#each overlay.bandRuns as band (band.deviations)}
			{#each band.upper as upper, position (position)}
				<path class="candlestickChartBandFill" d={getAreaPath(upper, band.lower[position] ?? [], "linear")} style:--candlestick-chart-series-color={overlay.color} />
				<path class="candlestickChartBandEdge" d={getLinePath(upper, "linear")} style:--candlestick-chart-series-color={overlay.color} />
				<path class="candlestickChartBandEdge" d={getLinePath(band.lower[position] ?? [], "linear")} style:--candlestick-chart-series-color={overlay.color} />
			{/each}
		{/each}
	{/each}
	{#each overlays as overlay (overlay.label)}
		{#each overlay.lineRuns as run, position (position)}
			<path class="candlestickChartOverlayLine" d={getLinePath(run, "linear")} style:--candlestick-chart-series-color={overlay.color} />
		{/each}
	{/each}
</g>

<style>
	/* Soft wash between a band's edges */
	.candlestickChartBandFill {
		fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--candlestick-chart-series-color) 8%, transparent);
	}

	/* Hairline band edges */
	.candlestickChartBandEdge {
		fill: none;
		stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--candlestick-chart-series-color) 55%, transparent);
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	/* Indicator line, thinner than a chart line so the candles stay the story */
	.candlestickChartOverlayLine {
		fill: none;
		stroke: var(--candlestick-chart-series-color);
		stroke-linecap: round;
		stroke-linejoin: round;
		stroke-width: 1.5px;
	}
</style>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Space in pixels between a band's edge and its label.
	const LABEL_OFFSET = 4;
	// Runs of neighboring candles in the same highlight or session; a highlight wins over a session.
	const bands = $derived.by(() => {
		const runs: { key: string; first: number; last: number; label: string; color: string; kind: "session" | "highlight" }[] = [];
		for (const index of ctx.visibleIndexes) {
			const highlight = ctx.highlights[ctx.candleHighlights[index]];
			const session = ctx.sessions[ctx.candleSessions[index]];
			const key = highlight ? `highlight-${ctx.candleHighlights[index]}` : session ? `session-${ctx.candleSessions[index]}` : "";
			const previous = runs.at(-1);
			// If the candle is in regular hours: it ends any band.
			if (!key) continue;
			// If the candle continues the band before it: extend that band.
			if (previous && previous.key === key && previous.last === index - 1) previous.last = index;
			else if (highlight) runs.push({ key, first: index, last: index, label: highlight.label ?? "", color: highlight.color ?? "var(--chart-4)", kind: "highlight" });
			else if (session) runs.push({ key, first: index, last: index, label: session.label, color: session.color ?? "var(--muted-foreground)", kind: "session" });
		}
		return runs.map((run) => {
			const x = ctx.x(run.first) - ctx.spacing / 2;
			const width = (run.last - run.first + 1) * ctx.spacing;
			// Only label a band wide enough to hold its label.
			return { ...run, x, width, showLabel: !!run.label && width > ctx.measureText([run.label]) + LABEL_OFFSET * 2 };
		});
	});
</script>

<!-- Shading behind the candles for sessions, such as pre-market, and highlights, such as earnings. -->
<g class="candlestickChartSessions">
	{#each bands as band (`${band.key}-${band.first}`)}
		<g style:--candlestick-chart-series-color={band.color} data-kind={band.kind}>
			<rect class="candlestickChartSession" x={band.x} y={ctx.marginTop} width={band.width} height={ctx.panesHeight} />
			{#if band.showLabel}
				<text class="candlestickChartSessionLabel" x={band.x + LABEL_OFFSET} y={ctx.marginTop + LABEL_OFFSET} dominant-baseline="hanging">{band.label}</text>
			{/if}
		</g>
	{/each}
</g>

<style>
	/* Soft wash, so the shading stays behind the candles */
	.candlestickChartSession {
		fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--candlestick-chart-series-color) 8%, transparent);
	}

	/* Highlights read a step stronger than sessions */
	[data-kind="highlight"] .candlestickChartSession {
		fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--candlestick-chart-series-color) 14%, transparent);
	}

	/* Band name; text stays in text colors */
	.candlestickChartSessionLabel {
		fill: var(--muted-foreground);
		font-size: inherit;
	}
</style>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const bottom = $derived(ctx.volumeTop + ctx.volumeHeight);
</script>

<!-- One volume bar per visible candle, in a lighter step of its direction color. -->
<g class="candlestickChartVolume">
	{#each ctx.visibleIndexes as index (index)}
		{@const candle = ctx.data[index]}
		{#if candle.volume}
			{@const top = ctx.volumeToY(candle.volume)}
			<rect class="candlestickChartVolumeBar" x={ctx.x(index) - ctx.bodyWidth / 2} y={top} width={ctx.bodyWidth} height={Math.max(1, bottom - top)} data-direction={candle.close >= candle.open ? "up" : "down"} data-active={index === ctx.activeIndex || undefined} />
		{/if}
	{/each}
</g>

<style>
	/* =============== Variants =============== */

	/* Recessive bars, so volume stays behind the price story */
	.candlestickChartVolumeBar[data-direction="up"] {
		fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--candlestick-chart-up, var(--chart-3)) 40%, transparent);
	}

	.candlestickChartVolumeBar[data-direction="down"] {
		fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--candlestick-chart-down, var(--destructive)) 40%, transparent);
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Hovered bar shows at full strength */
	.candlestickChartVolumeBar[data-active][data-direction="up"] {
		fill: var(--candlestick-chart-up, var(--chart-3));
	}

	.candlestickChartVolumeBar[data-active][data-direction="down"] {
		fill: var(--candlestick-chart-down, var(--destructive));
	}
</style>

description: A candlestick chart with trading sessions, a volume pane, VWAP, moving averages, Bollinger bands, price levels, live updates, zoom, and pan.
